sources.title: Principles of Digital Communications I
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Nyquist 成形脈衝：滾降與符元率
related.titleEn: Nyquist pulse shaping: roll-off and symbol rate
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 4000000 bit/s 與 2000000 bit/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 4000000 bit/s and 2000000 bit/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋2000000 symbol/s與1600000 symbol/s，建立pulse_budget.csv、頻譜邊界圖、ISI待測清單，並完成以下驗收：需求1.8 Msymbol/s時僅alpha=0.2符合本模型；另驗有限長濾波器的殘餘ISI。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 2000000 symbol/s and 1600000 symbol/s; create pulse_budget.csv, a spectral-boundary diagram and an ISI test list; apply this acceptance decision: Only alpha=0.2 meets a 1.8 Msymbol/s target in this model; separately check residual ISI of finite-length filters.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 高斯加性白雜訊模型的容量為 B log2(1+S/N)；S/N 必須是線性比，容量上界不等於實際吞吐。 展開基準式 1000000*log2(1+15)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把 C/B 還原為 2^(C/B)-1，分別得到15與3；另記編碼、導頻及封包開銷尚未納入。 將兩條推導一起存入 capacity.csv、SNR單位表、容量反算表。
從原理 升餘弦通帶所需頻寬 B=(1+alpha)Rs；固定頻寬時滾降增加會降低可容納符元率。 展開基準式 2400000/(1+0.2)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把兩個符元率代回頻寬式，均應得到2.4 MHz；用頻譜圖標出正負頻率與通帶定義。 將兩條推導一起存入 pulse_budget.csv、頻譜邊界圖、ISI待測清單。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from For an AWGN channel C=B log2(1+S/N); S/N is linear and the bound is not application throughput., expand baseline expression 1000000*log2(1+15); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Invert using 2^(C/B)-1 to recover 15 and 3; coding, pilots and packet overhead are not yet included. Save both derivations with capacity.csv, an SNR unit table and inverse-capacity checks.

Starting from Raised-cosine passband bandwidth is B=(1+alpha)Rs; increasing roll-off lowers symbol rate at fixed bandwidth., expand baseline expression 2400000/(1+0.2); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Substitute both symbol rates into the bandwidth equation to recover 2.4 MHz; mark signed frequencies and the passband definition. Save both derivations with pulse_budget.csv, a spectral-boundary diagram and an ISI test list.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GSM TDMA：時槽與保護時間排程
related.titleEn: GSM TDMA: slot and guard-time scheduling
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 4000000 bit/s 與 2000000 bit/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 4000000 bit/s and 2000000 bit/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋4560 microsecond/frame與4320 microsecond/frame，建立tdma_slots.csv、到達偏移表、保護時間驗收，並完成以下驗收：若到達不確定度45 microsecond，30的保護時間不能接受；60的配置須另付出資料時間成本。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 4560 microsecond/frame and 4320 microsecond/frame; create tdma_slots.csv, arrival offsets and guard-time acceptance; apply this acceptance decision: At45 microseconds arrival uncertainty, guard30 fails; guard60 incurs the explicit data-time cost.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 高斯加性白雜訊模型的容量為 B log2(1+S/N)；S/N 必須是線性比，容量上界不等於實際吞吐。 展開基準式 1000000*log2(1+15)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把 C/B 還原為 2^(C/B)-1，分別得到15與3；另記編碼、導頻及封包開銷尚未納入。 將兩條推導一起存入 capacity.csv、SNR單位表、容量反算表。
從原理 TDMA以互不重疊的時槽分配共用媒介；資料時間須扣保護時間，時槽數與語音淨位元率不可直接等同。 展開基準式 8*(600-30)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列8個槽的起訖與資料區，總框長4800 microsecond不變；確認無資料跨越保護邊界。 將兩條推導一起存入 tdma_slots.csv、到達偏移表、保護時間驗收。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from For an AWGN channel C=B log2(1+S/N); S/N is linear and the bound is not application throughput., expand baseline expression 1000000*log2(1+15); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Invert using 2^(C/B)-1 to recover 15 and 3; coding, pilots and packet overhead are not yet included. Save both derivations with capacity.csv, an SNR unit table and inverse-capacity checks.

Starting from TDMA divides a shared medium into nonoverlapping slots; guard time reduces data time and slot count is not a voice payload rate., expand baseline expression 8*(600-30); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List start/end/data intervals for eight slots; total frame duration remains4800 microseconds and no data crosses a guard boundary. Save both derivations with tdma_slots.csv, arrival offsets and guard-time acceptance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
